scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,cms -c cyan,green "bun run --cwd apps/web dev" "bun run --cwd apps/cms develop"
scripts.build: bun run lint && bun run build:cms && bun run build:web
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:browser && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:install-browser: bun run --cwd apps/web playwright install chromium
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/cms typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run format:check && eslint apps/web/src apps/web/tests && bun run typecheck
